## Overview

**Logistic Regression Analysis** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Binary outcomes with odds ratios, ROC/AUC, and stakeholder interpretation.

## Background & Motivation

**Logistic Analysis.pdf** — PDS focus on odds ratios and probabilistic classification.

Many business outcomes are binary (approve/deny, buy/not buy); logistic regression remains the interpretable baseline analysts must master.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Prepare binary target and numeric/categorical predictors
- Fit logistic regression (statsmodels or sklearn)
- Report **odds ratios** and coefficient signs
- ROC/AUC and confusion matrix
- Write interpretation for non-technical stakeholders

## Data Collection & Preparation

Course-provided or project CSV with binary outcome (see PDF).

## Methodology & Analysis

Data prep → logistic fit → diagnostic plots → business narrative.

## Model Evaluation

AUC, calibration, confusion matrix at chosen threshold.

## Results & Key Learnings

Interpretable classification report emphasizing coefficient storytelling.
